title: Are We Testing the Wrong Quantum Bugs? A Study of Fault Representation Gaps in Quantum Software Testing
abstract: arXiv:2610.22089v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Quantum software relies on compilers, intermediate representations, and execution frameworks that transform programs before execution. Faults in these components can change the behavior of otherwise correct quantum programs. Yet quantum testing techniques are often evaluated using mutation-generated faults and curated bug benchmarks. We investigate how well the faults represented by these artifacts reflect those encountered in modern quantum software. We audit four quantum mutation-testing tools and three curated bug benchmarks, and collect 410 verified bugs from ten quantum software repositories over two years. We classify faults from all three sources into a common taxonomy of 56 bug families and compare their representation across mutation operators, curated benchmarks, and recent real-world bugs. translated_title: 我们是否在测试错误的量子缺陷？量子软件测试中缺陷表示差距的研究
translated_abstract: 量子软件依赖编译器、中间表示和执行框架，这些组件会在程序执行前对其进行转换。这些组件中的缺陷可能会改变原本正确的量子程序的行为。然而，量子测试技术通常使用变异生成的缺陷和人工整理的缺陷基准来评估。我们研究了这些工件所表示的缺陷能在多大程度上反映现代量子软件中实际遇到的缺陷。我们审查了四个量子变异测试工具和三个人工整理的缺陷基准，并在两年内从十个量子软件仓库中收集了410个已验证的缺陷。我们将来自这三个来源的缺陷统一归类到一个包含56个缺陷族的分类体系中，并比较了它们在变异算子、人工整理基准和近期真实世界缺陷中的覆盖情况。变异测试工具支持20个缺陷族，人工整理的基准又增加了15个。然而，410个真实世界缺陷中仅有56个（13.7%）属于……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过审查量子变异测试工具和人工整理的缺陷基准，并收集两年内410个真实缺陷，揭示量子软件测试评估中存在显著的缺陷表示差距——现有变异算子与基准仅覆盖极少数缺陷族，无法充分代表真实量子软件中的缺陷。
en_tdlr: By auditing quantum mutation-testing tools and curated benchmarks against 410 verified real-world bugs, this study reveals a significant fault representation gap, showing that existing mutation operators and benchmarks cover only a small fraction of the bug families actually encountered in modern quantum software.
